description:
The proposed development comprises the extension of the existing single-storey rear extension to the rear of the property.

The property currently benefits from an existing single-storey rear extension measuring approximately 3.0 metres in depth. The proposal is to extend the existing rear extension by a further 2.5 metres, resulting in an overall rear extension depth of approximately 5.5 metres from the original rear wall of the dwelling.

The proposed extension will remain single storey and will incorporate a flat roof design. The extension is intended to provide additional internal floor space to the existing kitchen, creating a larger and more practical open-plan kitchen and family living area.

The rear elevation will incorporate bi-fold doors, providing increased natural light and improved access and visual connection between the kitchen and the existing rear garden.

The proposed extension will be designed to complement the existing dwelling and will use materials and finishes that are sympathetic to the existing property. The development will remain proportionate to the existing house and garden and will not involve any additional storeys or alterations to the roof of the main dwelling.

The proposed works are therefore limited to the enlargement of the existing single-storey rear extension to provide additional kitchen and living accommodation, together with the installation of bi-fold doors to the rear elevation.
